_meta.usage: 1998–2008 plates (code in a box on the left, blue digits, then A 1234 for private cars or AB 123 for companies): type the whole plate or only the two-digit code
_meta.note: Codes of the 1998–2008 format; they overlap today's ranges (10 was Tashkent city then, Tashkent Region now), so look a plate up under the format it has. These plates are on old cars and point to the region of registration at the time.
_meta.miss_note: not a 1998–2008 Uzbek plate: a current plate (letter, three digits, two letters after the code; use `--kind plate`), a foreign-resident or company plate, or a plate of another country
